definition: Policy, planning, assessment and institutional arrangements that enable an organisation or government to adopt and govern cloud computing. Includes cloud-first or cloud-smart policy, cloud strategy, target architecture, cloud readiness, application and infrastructure assessments, business cases, migration roadmaps, operating models, cloud centres of excellence, workforce development, governance and adoption planning. Excludes generic digital strategies that merely mention cloud, procurement of ordinary hosting with no cloud service model, and deployment or migration work without a strategy, readiness or governance component. Cloud security controls are included only when part of the adoption framework rather than a standalone cybersecurity activity.
